source: UNSW IoT Attack Traces verified in V33/V34
purpose: Detect an unseen attack family from its first observable network change and forecast malicious continuation over the next four minutes.
claim_scope: zero-day-like unseen-family early progression forecasting; not prediction before the first malicious packet and not universal zero-day prediction
history: four one-minute rows ending at the current minute; model input is the 3x12 derivative sequence of V37 scale-free fraction/concentration channels
positive_training_sample: current minute is in the first 120 seconds of a non-held-out attack and the same annotated attack remains active in the future horizon
locked_family_rule: all samples overlapping a locked family in history/current/future are excluded from every V41 development split and are never scored

split.assignment: SHA256(device:block_start) modulo 100: train<60, calibration<75, policy<88, test otherwise
split.heldout_family_rule: any sample overlapping the development held-out family is excluded from train/calibration/policy; held-out early-event candidates are scored only for event evaluation
split.block_overlap: samples must be wholly inside one 30-minute block

model.supervised_head: HistGradientBoostingClassifier on flattened invariant derivative trajectory
model.unknown_head: IsolationForest fit only to benign train samples
model.calibration: supervised logit calibration on calibration split only
model.selection: policy split only; maximize known-attack progression recall subject to <=1% policy benign FPR

final_validation: locked; after V41 development, a newly reserved external campaign/dataset is still required for a final zero-day forecasting claim
